status: review-only; not wired into the build
policy: Records omitted from this file are deliberate keeps from the already source-audited translation, not unreviewed text.

changes.TT2/g0/r0: Pierre: God, I'm begging you! Help us poor bastards! God! Are you even listening?!
changes.TT2/g0/r1: Pierre: Why'd it have to be a devil?! Me: What the hell is going on?!
changes.TT2/g0/r3: Something smells burned… The candle flame…! Pierre: Aaaah!!
changes.TT2/g0/r5: Am I… dead?! My body's gone, but I'm still alive!
changes.TT2/g0/r9: What the hell is going on?! I'm in somebody else's body!
changes.TT2/g0/r11: His skin is flaking off. Something is seriously wrong.
changes.TT2/g0/r12: Pierre: The war's going badly, and times are rotten… I got desperate enough to pray to God… and then Mister Devil showed up.
changes.TT2/g0/r21: Going outside now would be asking for trouble.
changes.TT2/g0/r22: "Lugot's granddaughter, Jeanne d'Arc, is a witch. The Church has ordered her execution."
changes.TT2/g0/r25: "Any woman bearing a scar must be reported to the Church at once. Anyone who conceals one will face severe punishment. —October 1428, Church of the Kingdom of France"
changes.TT2/g1/r4: October 1428 — A castle town in France.
changes.TT2/g1/r11: Old Man: Know the answer to this one?
changes.TT2/g1/r12: What land did the Crusaders attempt to reclaim?
changes.TT2/g1/r15: What long war did England fight against France?
changes.TT2/g1/r16: The three estates were the clergy, the nobility, and…?
changes.TT2/g1/r17: What was a merchants' trade association called?
changes.TT2/g1/r20: Old Man: Every answer right! You're quite the scholar. Here's your reward.
changes.TT2/g1/r22: Old Man: Truth and oil always rise to the surface. It's a French proverb.
changes.TT2/g1/r26: Old Man: Want some wine? That's your reward. Glug, glug, glug…
changes.TT2/g2/r3: He doesn't seem very focused on his work.
changes.TT2/g2/r4: Chino: Witch hunts… What a rotten age to live in.
changes.TT2/g2/r6: Chino: Damn it! Poor Jeanne's going to burn!
changes.TT2/g2/r15: Gordo: Pierre, listen to this! I hear Chino fell for Jeanne the moment he saw her.
changes.TT2/g2/r17: Gordo: Chino, get this! They say the bishop burns girls and then eats them!
changes.TT2/g2/r18: Gordo: Ah… about that debt. Can you give me a little longer?
changes.TT2/g2/r20: Gordo: Tch… fine. Take this monk's robe.
changes.TT2/g2/r23: Gordo: I already gave you one.
changes.TT2/g2/r26: Gordo: At this rate, I'll never find a wife.
changes.TT2/g2/r28: Chino: D-don't be crazy! I can't do that! Pierre: Tch! Coward! Some man you are! Hic!
changes.TT2/g3/r1: Pierre: You idiot! Hic! You're still saying no?!
changes.TT2/g3/r3: Pierre: Damn it! We can't even save one girl?! Raaagh! Chino: H-hey! Take it easy! Pierre: Shut up! Wham!
changes.TT2/g3/r5: He's ranting. Pierre: Shut it, dammit!
changes.TT2/g3/r10: Lugot: My granddaughter Jeanne is a good girl. She's no witch!
changes.TT2/g3/r12: Lugot: I'm an old man. Please, Chino… save Jeanne in my place!
changes.TT2/g3/r13: Lugot: Thank you, Chino! Pierre: That's my man! Well said!
changes.TT2/g3/r14: Lugot: Church officials can come and go from the jail freely. Pierre: Go see Gordo. He's got a monk's robe.
changes.TT2/g3/r15: Lugot: Jeanne is deeply devout. She never misses her daily prayers.
changes.TT2/g3/r16: Pierre: Hic! You heartless bastard! Still saying no?! Look at the old man!
changes.TT2/g3/r18: Pierre: Looks good on you, Chino.
changes.TT2/g3/r23: Pierre: Save Jeanne, you coward! Chino: What about you?! Pierre: You idiot! I don't have the guts!
changes.TT2/g3/r24: Pierre: You're a locksmith! A cell lock should be nothing to you. Pop it open! Hic! Chino: Are you insane?! Lugot: Poor Jeanne…
changes.TT2/g3/r25: Lugot: Wake up, Chino. You're the only one who can help her. Pierre: Me? I'm useless.
changes.TT2/g3/r26: Lugot: Please! Save my granddaughter! She only just turned sixteen! Guard: She must await her trial.
changes.TT2/g3/r28: His eyes are red and swollen from crying.
changes.TT2/g3/r31: Guard: Women with scars may be witches. Those are the Church's orders.
changes.TT2/g4/r0: Guard: The bishop… What in God's name is he thinking?
changes.TT2/g4/r1: Guard: Is he really going to burn her?
changes.TT2/g4/r7: Guard: Don't tell anyone. Glug… Ahhh! Just between us… the bishop takes girls he fancies down below and tortures them. It's disgraceful!
changes.TT2/g4/r9: Man: The jail is packed with women accused of witchcraft. At this rate, France won't have any women left.
changes.TT2/g4/r10: Man: They burn them here? Man: Those poor women…
changes.TT2/g4/r12: Lugot looks awful. Poor man… Should we carry him?
changes.TT2/g4/r14: Jailer: No. I need the Bishop's permission. I can't let her out. Me: But… Jailer: I know how you feel. Please go back.
changes.TT2/g4/r18: Woman: I'm not a witch! Please let me out! My child is waiting for me at home. Please, Brother…
changes.TT2/g4/r19: Jailer: I need the Bishop's permission. I cannot free them.
changes.TT2/g4/r20: Woman: Why does this make me a witch?! This scar on my leg? I got it when I fell! Woman: A crab bit me!
changes.TT2/g4/r22: Woman: Are they going to burn us? Woman: Oh, God…
changes.TT2/g4/r23: Bishop: State your name. Girl: …Jeanne d'Arc. Bishop: Jeanne d'Arc?! So… it really is you.
changes.TT2/g4/r27: Jeanne is bound with thick rope.
changes.TT2/g5/r2: Jeanne: We have to get out of here!
changes.TT2/g5/r3: Bishop: The one I worship gave me an order: "Kill Jeanne d'Arc! If she lives, she will become a threat in years to come." Jeanne: … Bishop: I've been hunting witches in hopes of finding you someday… I never expected it to happen this soon.
changes.TT2/g5/r4: Bishop: You will remain here until the stake is ready.
changes.TT2/g5/r6: I untie the thick rope and gently lower Jeanne to the floor.
changes.TT2/g5/r8: This rope is way too long.
